    • attemptCapture

      public static CaptureRecord attemptCapture(Pirate target, Character captor, boolean isDead) throws InvalidCaptorException
      Purpose: Runs a full capture - validation, status change, and payout - in the correct order.
      Parameters:
      target - the pirate being captured, rejected if null or not currently FREE
      captor - the character making the capture
      isDead - true if the target was killed rather than taken alive
      Returns:
      the resulting capture record
      Throws:
      InvalidCaptorException - if the captor is null or a pirate
      IllegalArgumentException - if the target is null or is not FREE
